lines.zh: 波塞冬踏浪而来，一步一顿
lines.en: Poseidon strides in with a heavy, rolling gait.
His feet are pale and waterlogged.
His two tridents clink as he moves.
His soaked hem drags the ground.
He walks the tide line without swerving.

lines.zh: 每走一步，水就从身上滴
lines.en: Every step shakes water from him.
He rounds the reef and walks on.

lines.zh: 他走得不快，但从不后退
lines.en: Not fast, but he never falls back.

lines.zh: 他的呼吸带着气泡的声音
lines.en: His breathing gurgles.
He shifts one trident to his other hand.

lines.zh: 波塞冬站着，两戟垂在身侧
lines.en: Poseidon stands, both tridents low.

lines.zh: 水从他下巴一滴一滴落下
lines.en: Water drips from his jaw.

lines.zh: 他把戟尖对着地面慢慢转
lines.en: He turns a trident point against the ground.

lines.zh: 他的头微微低着，像在听海
lines.en: His head is low, as if listening to the sea.

lines.zh: 他的皮肤上有盐的痕迹
lines.en: Salt marks his skin.

lines.zh: 他把另一把戟举起来端详
lines.en: He raises the other trident to look.
Old cord wraps its shaft.
His breathing thickens the air.

lines.zh: 他慢慢把重心挪到另一只脚
lines.en: He shifts his weight to the other foot.

lines.zh: 他忽然站直，水从肩头滑落
lines.en: He straightens; water slides off his shoulders.

lines.zh: 他朝海的方向偏了偏头
lines.en: He tilts his head toward the sea.

lines.zh: 他的声音像从水底传上来
lines.en: His voice seems to come from underwater.
He plants a trident butt on the ground.

lines.zh: 回声在礁石间弹了一下
lines.en: The sound bounces off the reef.
He raises an open palm.
A little water balls in his palm.
Poseidon lifts his eyes to you.

lines.zh: 他的目光像潮水一样压过来
lines.en: His gaze presses in like a tide.

lines.zh: 他把两把戟都抬了起来
lines.en: He raises both tridents.
He sizes you from head to foot.
One step, and water splashes.

lines.zh: 他歪头，像在称你的重量
lines.en: He tilts his head, weighing you.

lines.zh: 他的喉咙里滚出一声低响
lines.en: A low sound rolls in his throat.
He points out at the sea.
Then the finger turns on you.
The meaning is clear.

lines.zh: 他退开半步，给你机会说话
lines.en: He backs half a step, letting you speak.
His patience is not large.

lines.zh: 波塞冬晃了一下，退了半步
lines.en: Poseidon sways and gives half a step.
Water bursts from the wound.
He growls, and it sounds like the sea.
He grips the shafts harder.
His breathing catches.
He presses a hand to his ribs.
He backs half a step and resets.
His gaze turns colder.
What seeps from the wound is not quite blood.
He does not retreat, only settles deeper.

lines.zh: 波塞冬看了看你手上的东西
lines.en: Poseidon glances at what you hold.
He lifts it on a trident point.
He flicks it into the sea.
Food means nothing to him.
He drops it back at your feet.
He shakes his head and wants no more.
He gestures for you to put it away.
His attention returns to the sea.

lines.zh: 他只对能用的东西有兴趣
lines.en: Only useful things hold his eye.
One look, and never a second.

lines.zh: 你撞上他，像撞上湿冷的墙
lines.en: You hit him like a cold wet wall.
He sways at the impact.
Water shakes loose at the contact.
He puts a hand out and shoves you back.

lines.zh: 他的戟柄横着挡在你面前
lines.en: A trident shaft bars your way.
He turns and lets you by.

lines.zh: 他的衣摆扫在你腿上，很凉
lines.en: His hem drags cold across your leg.

lines.zh: 他低头看了看自己的手
lines.en: He glances at his own hand.
He takes a firmer grip.
He takes no offence.

lines.zh: 两个海中的身影并肩站着
lines.en: Two figures of the sea stand abreast.

lines.zh: 他们的戟尖朝向同一个方向
lines.en: Their tridents point the same way.
He lays a hand on the other's shoulder.
Water moves between them.
They look to the horizon together.
Their breathing keeps one rhythm.

lines.zh: 他们一起把戟插进沙里
lines.en: Together they plant their tridents in the sand.

lines.zh: 潮水漫过来，他们没有退
lines.en: The tide comes in; neither retreats.

lines.zh: 他们交换了一句湿冷的话
lines.en: They trade a cold, wet word.
The shore is quiet for now.

lines.zh: 波塞冬用戟尖挑起东西
lines.en: Poseidon lifts the item on a trident tip.

lines.zh: 他把它甩到另一只手上
lines.en: He flips it to his other hand.
He looks, then tucks it at his hip.
What is useless, he kicks away.
Water keeps dripping as he takes it.

lines.zh: 他把东西举到眼前照了照
lines.en: He holds it up to the light.

lines.zh: 他把它塞进湿透的衣服里
lines.en: He stuffs it into his soaked clothing.
He weighs it and nods.
He pins the prize underfoot.
Then he raises both tridents again.
Poseidon separates his tridents.
He sets his feet apart.

lines.zh: 潮水在他身后涨了起来
lines.en: The tide rises behind him.
Water glints on his trident points.
He says something low.
The sea wind picks up suddenly.
He raises one trident over his shoulder.

lines.zh: 水从他手臂上流到戟柄
lines.en: Water runs down his arm to the shaft.
His stare pins you.
Water smooths the sand around him.
He steps forward.
That step throws the water outward.
He levels the other trident.
His breathing slows but deepens.
The sky darkens a shade.
He is done listening.
Seawater starts running to your feet.

lines.zh: 他的戟尖对准了你的胸口
lines.en: A trident point aims at your chest.
Poseidon paces a slow circuit.
Water follows each of his steps.

lines.zh: 他试着用戟尖点你一下
lines.en: He probes at you with a trident point.
He withdraws and comes in another way.
One trident high, one low.
He is closing your left and right.
Water has reached your ankles.

lines.zh: 他抬戟轻轻敲了下地面
lines.en: He taps the ground with a trident.
A small jet of water rises from the sand.
He bends his knees slightly.
A point stays trained on you.
He seems to wait for you.

lines.zh: 他把一把戟投掷般举起
lines.en: He raises one trident as if to throw.
Water swirls at his feet.
His breathing goes very steady.
He leaves you no exit.

lines.zh: 他的影子在海面上晃动
lines.en: His shadow sways on the water.
He leans his body forward.
Both tridents come up together.
He is waiting for one movement.
Poseidon thrusts a trident straight in.
The other sweeps after it.
A trident point rakes your armour.
He shoves you back with a shaft.
His stamp throws up a sheet of water.
He brings a trident down like a club.

lines.zh: 水被他的动作卷成一道墙
lines.en: Water curls into a wall with his swing.
Two thrusts, two different lines.

lines.zh: 他的戟尖钉进你脚边的沙
lines.en: A trident point stabs the sand by your foot.

lines.zh: 他拔出戟，带起一股湿沙
lines.en: He wrenches it free with a spray of sand.
A shoulder check hits your chest.
He backs half a step and raises again.
His breathing has not slipped.
Heavy motion, precise landing.
The sea suddenly swells shoreward.

lines.zh: 一个高大的身影从浪里站起
lines.en: A tall figure rises out of the surf.
Water sheets off him.

lines.zh: 他一手一把戟，站在浅滩
lines.en: A trident in each hand, he stands in the shallows.
He lifts his head and reads the sky.
He walks slowly up the sand.
Wet sand gives under his feet.

lines.zh: 他把一把戟在手里转了个向
lines.en: He spins one trident around.
Thunder rolls in the distance.
His breathing is deeper than the surf.
He stops, both tridents hanging.
The wind opens his hem.

lines.zh: 他的目光扫过整片海岸
lines.en: His gaze sweeps the whole shore.
Then he sees you.
He does not move at once.

lines.zh: 他把戟尖一点点抬起来
lines.en: He lifts a trident point by degrees.
The tide line retreats from his feet.
Only his breathing remains on the shore.
He is in position.
The waves knit together behind him.

lines.zh: 身上冒起白汽，他甩了下手臂
lines.en: Steam rises off him; he shakes his arm.

lines.zh: 落地时他单膝磕进沙里
lines.en: He lands and a knee drives into the sand.

lines.zh: 水淹过头，他反而安静下来
lines.en: Water closes over him and he goes calm.

lines.zh: 冲击把他推得滑退数格
lines.en: The blast slides him back several blocks.

lines.zh: 箭扎进他的肩，他随手拔掉
lines.en: An arrow strikes his shoulder; he pulls it out.

lines.zh: 怪力入体，他低声念了句什么
lines.en: Odd force enters; he mutters something.

lines.zh: 久未进食，他的动作更沉
lines.en: Long unfed, his motion turns heavier.
Lightning falls and he meets it with a trident.

lines.zh: 虚空拽他，他把戟插进沙里
lines.en: The void pulls; he drives a trident into the sand.
